title: Metal Gear Solid: The Legacy Collection

info.about: Metal Gear Solid: The Legacy Collection is a video game compilation released exclusively for the PlayStation 3. It includes all of the mainline Metal Gear games directed and designed by Hideo Kojima that were released from 1987 through 2012.
info.trivia: Its extras include motion-comic adaptations of the Metal Gear Solid graphic novels and a 100-page booklet of promotional art.
info.why: It is a PlayStation 3 exclusive and the one package holding every mainline Kojima Metal Gear released from 1987 to 2012.
